summary.text: Dan Weldon is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 64 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on August 18, 2026.
An attorney, he also sought the Republican nomination for Florida's 14th Congressional District, from whose primary Ballotpedia says he was disqualified.

paragraphs.text: Dan Weldon graduated from Tampa Catholic High School and earned a law degree from the University of Florida, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as an attorney.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a Tampa native who walked on to the University of Florida football team as a linebacker and founded a conservative student organization on campus.
He said he was elected chairman of the College Republicans of Florida in 2019, graduated with honors from the University of Florida Levin College of Law, and began his legal career as a prosecutor.
